top_choice_rationale: P004 pairs two distinct, concept-level achievements with clean attribution: Crews and Deshaies for conceiving and establishing event-driven degradation by induced proximity, a new, widely reproduced principle, and Shokat for structure-guided covalent targeting of mutant KRAS, which is validated by approved drugs. The narrow degradation citation avoids claiming the glue strand. P001 follows because it carries the same degradation core with Ciulli, whose structure-guided work is a strong claim. P002 widens the citation to cereblon, which identifies the target of an existing drug and is a different kind of contribution. P003 pairs the degradation core with ionizable lipid nanoparticles, where Cullis alone understates a collective, partly industrial effort. No award is last because the degradation core is mature enough to defend.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; shares Lund affiliation with committee colleagues Linke and Sparr, but has no documented link to any laureate named in the slate
